content: From storage to collaboration, data collection, automation, and AI — each app is built for a different job. Use the graduation cap icon on an app card to take or replay its tour.

comment.text: Body of the Dashboard onboarding tour step that highlights the row of app cards (Files, Rooms, Forms, AI agents, and so on). The graduation cap icon on each card starts that app's own tour.
